name: PHP SQL Strings

sql-heredoc.comment: Override VS Code's SQL/DQL heredoc wrapper so its content has the same ancestor scopes as double-quoted SQL while preserving heredoc interpolation.
sql-heredoc.name: string.quoted.double.sql.php

sql-nowdoc.comment: SQL/DQL nowdoc counterpart. Nowdocs intentionally omit PHP interpolation, matching VS Code's built-in behavior.
sql-nowdoc.name: string.quoted.single.sql.php

sql-double-quoted-inline.comment: Recognizes complete queries and partial fragments that start with a generated SQL keyword or function call, with optional wrapping parentheses.
sql-double-quoted-inline.name: string.quoted.double.sql.php

sql-single-quoted-inline.comment: Single-quoted counterpart of the extended inline SQL-string rule.
sql-single-quoted-inline.name: string.quoted.single.sql.php

possible-sql-double-quoted-multiline.comment: The nameless outer rule carries tokenizer state across blank lines and parenthesis-only prefix lines. Its child assigns the same SQL-string scope used by the inline rule once the first SQL starter is known.

possible-sql-single-quoted-multiline.comment: Single-quoted counterpart of the nameless pending state.

leading-subquery-parentheses-double.comment: Keep the multiline detector pending when opening parentheses occupy their own line while giving the speculative prefix the scopes it will have if a later SQL starter confirms the string.
leading-subquery-parentheses-double.name: string.quoted.double.sql.php source.sql.embedded.php

leading-subquery-parentheses-single.comment: Single-quoted counterpart of the speculative SQL parenthesis rule.
leading-subquery-parentheses-single.name: string.quoted.single.sql.php source.sql.embedded.php

non-sql-double-quoted-content.comment: Once non-whitespace prose appears first, keep the rest of the value a normal PHP string so a later SQL-looking line cannot cause a false positive.
non-sql-double-quoted-content.name: string.quoted.double.php
